opening.argument: The speaker presents a OneCoin dashboard and ties a 5-euro plan to an asserted tenfold profit advantage over a 1-euro plan. A signup-linked free-token benefit and the claim that someone with 10 dollars could still win reinforce the same appeal: payment decisions are connected to unusually favorable financial outcomes. These claims establish a deceptive token-investment pitch, while the recording leaves the exact token conditions, full plan terms, and realized returns unestablished.
